name: Voronoi Grid Ray Traversal
aliases: Straight path calculation through 3D Voronoi grid
Straight path traversal in Voronoi grid
definition: An algorithm to calculate the consecutive intersection points of a photon ray with Voronoi cell walls, determining the distance traveled in each cell until the ray exits the domain or a cell.
summary: Voronoi Grid Ray Traversal computes precise straight-line paths through unstructured 3D Voronoi tessellations to determine radiation field properties, avoiding the directional spread errors of Delaunay edge approximations.
